question: In which year did Robert Brown observe the zigzag movement of colloidal particles in solution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1827**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **1827** is the year when **Robert Brown** observed the **zigzag movement of colloidal particles in solution**.
 
• This phenomenon is known as **Brownian motion**.
 
• **Brownian motion** is the random movement of particles suspended in a fluid
